question: What is the value of 1980 ÷ 9 + [-77 + {-1980 + ((1)/(4) of 7920)}] ?
solution:
**Given:**

1980 ÷ 9 + [-77 + {-1980 + ((1)/(4) of 7920)}]

Concept used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47485e25d1b30c57dc271863db8b99be0c8e209069b2596cc885911d898a8a78.png] 

Calculation:

1980 ÷ 9 + [-77 + {-1980 + ((1)/(4) of 7920)}] 

⇒ 1980 ÷ 9 + [-77 + {-1980 +1980}] 

⇒ 220 + -77

⇒ 143

∴ The correct answer is 143.
